verdict: Palantir's revenue jumped 30% to $726M as U.S. sales surged 44% on AI demand — and it stayed solidly profitable, keeping $144M for shareholders, then raised its full-year outlook.

segments.name: Government
segments.note: Software for governments, above all the U.S. military and intelligence agencies — U.S. government revenue grew 40% YoY to $320M.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.note: Software for companies — U.S. commercial revenue jumped 54% to $179M as the AIP 'bootcamp' push kept winning customers.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Sales teams and the 'bootcamp' try-before-you-buy push that has been winning commercial customers.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the platforms — Gotham, Foundry and the AIP AI layer.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company: legal, finance and offices.

otherDetail: Interest income of $52M on Palantir's cash pile, less $8M of other expense — a net +$44M below operating profit.
footerNote: Net income here is Palantir's total net income of $149M; $144M of it is attributable to common stockholders (the rest belongs to noncontrolling interests). Segment figures are from the segment note in Palantir's Q3 2024 Form 10-Q, rounded to the nearest $M; Commercial is shown as $318M so the segments tie to the $726M total.

takeaways.title: A U.S.-driven AI surge
takeaways.text: U.S. revenue grew 44% YoY to $499M — U.S. commercial up 54% and U.S. government up 40% — and Palantir raised its full-year revenue guidance to about $2.81B.

takeaways.title: Deal-making at full tilt
takeaways.text: Palantir closed 104 deals worth over $1M each in the quarter, and its customer count grew 39% YoY as AIP bootcamps kept converting into contracts.

takeaways.title: Cash generation stayed elite
takeaways.text: Adjusted free cash flow was $435M — 60 cents of every revenue dollar — and Palantir ended the quarter with $4.6B of cash and Treasury securities.

oneTimers: Stock-based compensation was $142M in the quarter — a real cost to shareholders through dilution, even though it is not cash. Palantir's adjusted (non-GAAP) operating income, which excludes it, was $276M versus $113M GAAP.
